questions.prompt: You spot free food at a wedding you weren't invited to. What’s your move?
choices: Walk straight up to the buffet like you own the venue, then casually shake hands with the groom's uncle.
Overthink at the entrance for 10 minutes before sneaking in behind your loudest friend.
Load your plate, then instantly panic that you'll end up on the evening news.
Corner the bride’s dad to deliver a 5-minute speech on his impeccable catering ROI.

questions.prompt: Your boss or professor announces a "surprise" test or review at 8:00 AM. You:
choices: Raise your hand and ask them to define the word "surprise" until they cancel it out of sheer frustration.
Smile politely on the outside while quietly narrating your own tragic backstory in your head.
Kiss every lucky ring on your fingers and bargain with the universe for one more day.
Turn around and flash an evil grin because you memorized the entire manual at 3:00 AM.

questions.prompt: Someone insults your best friend in front of a crowd. How do you handle it?
choices: Humiliate them with a weirdly specific science experiment or a devastatingly calm roast.
Pull everyone aside for a heartfelt monologue with imaginary sad background music.
Look terrified at first, then immediately throw hands anyway because loyalty comes first.
Try to defend your friend using big words you don't understand, making everything ten times worse.

questions.prompt: Life is falling apart and nothing makes sense. What is your coping mechanism?
choices: Take apart a perfectly working household appliance just to feel something.
Type a dramatic, life-changing confession text, stare at it for an hour, and delete it.
Sit on a rooftop contemplating your life choices while waiting for a miracle.
Stare at your old trophies and certificates to remind yourself that you’re still better than everyone else.

questions.prompt: Be honest: what is your biggest toxic trait?
choices: Giving unsolicited life advice like you’re a wandering monk with an engineering degree.
Fixing everyone else’s problems while completely ignoring your own dumpster fire.
Treating every minor inconvenience like a certified apocalypse.
Bragging endlessly and having zero self-awareness when everyone is roasting you behind your back.

results.name: Rancho
results.description: Curiosity comes first. You would take the machine apart before looking for its manual.

results.name: Farhan
results.description: You notice the story behind the chaos, especially when a friend needs you.

results.name: Raju
results.description: You feel every risk deeply and still show up for the people you love.

results.name: Chatur
results.description: You came prepared, memorized the speech, and have the certificates to prove it.

Series.title: Which Hogwarts house do you belong to?

questions.prompt: There’s a giant, glowing door labeled "DO NOT OPEN: CERTAIN DEATH." What’s your move?
choices: Kick it open immediately without checking if anyone is backing you up.
Pick the lock, see what's inside, and quietly use it as leverage later.
Stand there for 20 minutes analyzing the ancient runes on the doorknob before touching it.
Put a sticky note over the warning that says "Free snacks inside" just to see what happens.

questions.prompt: Your group chat is planning a trip, and everything is falling apart. Who are you?
choices: The one booking non-refundable flights at 2:00 AM and yelling "We’ll figure it out when we land!"
The mastermind who secretly booked the best room for yourself three weeks ago.
The human spreadsheet calculating split expenses down to the exact decimal.
The emotional support friend bringing snacks, band-aids, and zero actual itinerary.

questions.prompt: Someone steals your lunch from the shared fridge. How do you retaliate?
choices: Call a dramatic all-hands meeting and challenge the thief to a duel in the parking lot.
Find out who did it, ruin their reputation over six months, and make it look like an accident.
Replace your lunch with something aggressively spicy and document the results like a science fair project.
Feel weirdly bad that they were hungry, then bake cookies for everyone tomorrow anyway.

questions.prompt: You’re given a magical invisibility cloak for 24 hours. Be honest—what are you actually doing?
choices: Sneaking into a restricted VIP area purely for the adrenaline rush.
Eavesdropping on your boss or rivals to gather top-tier blackmail.
Breaking into a closed museum or library so nobody interrupts your peace and quiet.
Spooking your friends in the kitchen and stealing fries straight off their plates.

questions.prompt: What is your biggest red flag?
choices: Zero impulse control—your brain says "bad idea," and your body is already doing it.
Holding a grudge since 2016 and treating minor board games like warfare.
Saying "Well, technically..." in arguments until everyone leaves the room.
Being dangerously loyal to people who definitely don't deserve your snacks.

results.name: Gryffindor
results.description: You go first. Working out the landing can wait.

results.name: Slytherin
results.description: You spot the opening and already have a plan for what comes next.

results.name: Ravenclaw
results.description: A locked door is just a particularly interesting question.

results.name: Hufflepuff
results.description: You remember who needs a snack, a seat, or someone on their side.

questions.prompt: Someone leaves you on "Seen" for 6 hours, then texts "Sorry busy tha." Your move?
choices: Reply "No worries 😊" while silently adding them to your mental hit-list until 2034.
Stare at the ceiling at 3:00 AM wondering if you’re actually the villain in everyone’s story.
Leave them on "Seen" for 3 business days, post a thirst trap/aesthetic coffee story, and reply "Omg just saw this!!"
Immediately send 14 memes in a row because you have zero self-respect and short-term memory loss.

questions.prompt: You get invited to a cousin's wedding where you know for a fact everyone is going to judge your life choices. How do you pull up?
choices: Dressed like you’re about to announce a hostile takeover of the family business.
Looking tired, underdressed, and ready to slip out the back door right after the naan hits the table.
Smiling politely at every auntie while mentally calculating how many minutes until you can go home and take off your shoes.
Starting fake drama between two random uncles just to keep yourself entertained.

questions.prompt: Your bank account hits Rs. 430 on the 18th of the month. What is your survival strategy?
choices: Still order iced coffee/loaded fries because "paise toh haath ki mail hain."
Walk around the house turning off fans and acting like a stressed-out 1990s PTV dad.
Convince your friend to pay by saying "Bro Easypaisa down hai, ghar ja ke bhejta hoon" (you will never send it).
Stare into the fridge 12 times expecting biryani to magically spawn.

questions.prompt: Someone tries to give you unsolicited life advice at a family dinner. You:
choices: Hit them with "Ji bilkul, aap sahi keh rahe hain" and immediately do the exact opposite.
Look them dead in the eye and ask a question about their own failed life choices so they panic and leave.
Nod respectfully on the outside while your soul leaves your body and floats toward the ceiling.
Somehow turn the conversation into an argument about cricket or politics so everyone forgets about you.

questions.prompt: Be honest—what is your actual red flag?
choices: You create fake scenarios in your head, get mad at people for what they did in your imagination, and ruin your own mood.
You act completely unbothered until someone mildly inconveniences you, then you act like a Victorian orphan.
You have 47 unfinished hobbies, 3,000 unread WhatsApp messages, and zero sense of urgency.
You laugh at the worst possible moments—funerals, serious talks, someone crying—your brain just glitches

results.name: Khaani ("Tumhein Dillagi")
results.description: Petty, stubborn, and powered entirely by spite—you will ruin your own sleep schedule just to prove a point.

results.name: Parizaad
results.description: Zero luck, maximum overthinking, and permanently stuck feeling like an unpaid extra in your own life.

results.name: Zindagi Gulzar Hai
results.description: Tired of everyone’s nonsense, allergies to fake people, and secretly judging the entire room while drinking chai.

results.name: Suno Chanda
results.description: Walking hazard with zero filter—you treat serious life crises like a comedy sketch and somehow survive anyway.

Personality.title: Can we guess your mental age?

questions.prompt: You’re buying a new shirt or jacket. Which one are you picking?
choices: Tight/fitted trendy cut that looks great today, even if it shrinks next month.
Slightly oversized "taake 3 saal baad bhi poori aaye" (and with dark colors so stains don’t show).
Nothing—you’re still wearing the faded, stretched-out shirt from 2018 as your official "ghar ke kapray."
Literally whatever is on 50% clearance sale, regardless of style.

questions.prompt: You just finished dinner at a restaurant and there’s half a bottle of mineral water left on the table. What’s your move?
choices: Leave it there without a second thought.
Take a quick sip before standing up, then leave it.
Pick it up and put it in your bag/car because "paise diye hain, zaya kyun karein?"
Take the bottle home, refill it with tap water, and keep it in the fridge for the next 6 months.

questions.prompt: You finish a fancy metal biscuit tin or an ice cream tub. What happens to it?
choices: Goes straight in the bin.
Used as a temporary trash bowl for peanut shells while watching TV, then thrown out.
Washed, dried, and officially becomes the new container for daal, leftover salan, or tea leaves.
Promoted to holding needles, threads, buttons, and 14 expired safety pins.

questions.prompt: You’re going on a 2-hour road trip or flight. What are you packing?
choices: Just your phone, charger, and vibes—you’ll buy snacks on the way.
A whole bag of home-cooked parathas, boiled eggs, and fruit so you don't have to buy "mehnga bahar ka khana."
A thermos of chai, Vicks VapoRub, Panadol, and an extra shawl "just in case AC zyada tez ho."
Headphones and a neck pillow so nobody talks to you the entire time.

questions.prompt: Someone leaves the room for 5 minutes and forgets to turn off the fan or light. You:
choices: Don't even notice it’s on.
Turn it off quietly when you walk past.
Turn it off immediately and yell across the house: "Bijli ka bill tumhara baap bharega?!"
Stand by the doorway counting how many rupees of electricity are being wasted per minute.

results.name: Teen spirit
results.description: You live in the moment, trust your taste, and figure out tomorrow when it arrives.

results.name: Twenty-something planner
results.description: You like a little independence and a backup plan, especially when snacks are involved.

results.name: The family grown-up
results.description: You remember the water bottle, the electricity bill, and the things everyone else forgets.

results.name: Old soul
results.description: You see the second life in a biscuit tin and know the value of a quiet afternoon.

Personality.title: Are you a red flag or a green flag?

questions.prompt: Someone you don’t feel like talking to texts you right as you open WhatsApp. What do you choose?
choices: Reply politely right away so they aren't left hanging.
Read it from the notification bar, turn off your Wi-Fi immediately, and pretend your phone died.
Leave them on "Seen" on WhatsApp while actively liking memes on Instagram.
Turn off read receipts, ignore them for 4 days, and reply "Omg sorry network issue tha" when you need a favor.

questions.prompt: You’re picking a small gift for someone you like. Which one are you choosing?
choices: Classic red flowers and their favorite chocolate—pure, genuine, zero mind games.
A cursed meme printed on a mug because romantic gestures make you cringe.
Red flowers, after ghosting them for two days just to keep them on their toes (classic Zamil move).
Literally nothing—you’ll just show up and say "Meri presence hi kaafi hai."

questions.prompt: You’re walking past a mirror or reflective car window in public. What do you choose to do?
choices: Walk right past like a normal person.
Do a quick, subtle hair check without breaking your stride.
Full stop, fix your hair/outfit for 10 seconds, and admire yourself like the main character.
Adjust your black shalwar kameez and practice your dramatic Zamil stare just in case someone is watching.

questions.prompt: You’re on a call with someone who is telling a long, boring story. Which move do you choose?
choices: Listen patiently and ask follow-up questions like an actual green flag.
Put the phone on speaker, mute yourself, and scroll TikTok while saying "Haan... sahi... bilkul" every 30 seconds.
Put your phone in airplane mode mid-sentence so it says "Call Failed" instead of "Call Ended."
Interrupt them to turn the conversation back to your own problems.

questions.prompt: Which late-night phone habit are you choosing tonight?
choices: Wishing everyone goodnight and actually going to sleep before midnight.
Putting your phone on Do Not Disturb while watching 300 reels in silence.
Posting a cryptic sad quote on your Close Friends story with only ONE person in the list.
Stalking someone’s profile from 2019, accidentally liking a photo, and immediately deactivating your account.

results.name: Certified Abu Bakr (Pure Green Flag)
results.description: Genuinely thoughtful, brings red flowers without the trauma, and never fakes a Wi-Fi outage.

results.name: Chaotic Beige Flag (Sneaky Introvert)
results.description: Not toxic, just allergic to phone calls—you live on Airplane Mode and DND, "par dil ke ache ho."

results.name: Peak Zamil (Certified Red Flag)
results.description: Master of hot-and-cold mind games—will bring red roses one day and disappear into thin air the next.

results.name: Menace to Society (Walking Hazard)
results.description: Unhinged, petty, and treating basic communication like a high-stakes espionage mission.
